parts.name: plinth_axle
parts.axle_post_note: diameter derived from the 13mm disc center bore via seated_pair-style peg_for(13, 'free'): 13 - 2*0.40 = 12.2mm, so all three discs free-spin on the post
parts.index_groove_note: 8 grooves at the same 45-degree positions as the 8 sockets and the 8 disc window-ring slots; one shared angular position list per shared_positions

parts.name: probe_pin
parts.shaft_length_note: calibrated: 3 x 10mm disc thickness + 10mm socket depth = 40mm, the exact distance from tier_disc_c's top face to a socket floor

print_plan.notes: plinth_axle prints bottom-face down (drum flat on the bed, axle post extruding straight up, sockets open upward with no overhang); each tier disc prints flat, thickest face down, windows are simple through-cuts needing no support; all four marker peg families print base-down, domed top up; probe_pin prints head-down (flared 16mm disc flat on the bed, 6mm shaft extruding straight up) — every part needs zero supports. No part exceeds the 246x246x251mm bed (largest is the 206x190x62mm plinth_axle), so nothing is tiled.

unstated_in_spec: idea.json's plinth_axle line gives 'a central 40mm axle post' with no unit qualifier (diameter vs height). A 40mm-diameter post cannot pass through the discs' stated 13mm center bore, so I read '40mm' as the post's HEIGHT (matching the pattern elsewhere of stating socket depth, not socket-post diameter, without a label) and derived the post's DIAMETER from the bore instead: peg_for(13mm bore, 'free' fit) = 12.2mm, matching tier_disc_a's own stated 'free-spinning on the axle post.'

probe_pin's stated total length ('Shared 62mm verification rod') conflicts with the calibration idea.json itself demands two sentences later: shaft length must equal the socket-to-tier_disc_c depth, which the idea's own other explicit numbers (3 x 10mm disc thickness + 10mm socket depth) fix at 40mm, not 62mm minus any plausible head thickness. Since the win condition's flush/proof distinction depends on this number being exactly right, I honored the calibration requirement over the literal '62mm' figure: shaft_length_mm=40.0, head_thickness_mm=6.0 (chosen, see below), total_length_mm=46.0.

probe_pin's head THICKNESS (as opposed to its stated 16mm flare diameter) is not given; chose 6mm as a graspable disc-head thickness, big enough to pinch and small enough to read as 'flared head' rather than a knob.

tier_disc_b and tier_disc_c grip-tab WIDTHS are not given (only tier_disc_a's paddle is stated at 18mm wide; b and c give only their 16mm projection). Set both to the same 18mm width as tier_disc_a for consistent handling size across all three discs, since nothing in the idea suggests they should differ.

plinth_axle's overall diameter is given only as '~190mm' (approximate). Pinned to exactly 190.0mm, matching the tier discs' explicit exact 190mm, since the art direction calls for the stack to read as one flush cylinder.

Exact angular layout of the plinth's 8 index grooves and the tier discs' 8 window-ring positions is not given. Modeled as one shared 45-degree, 8-position ring (radius 75mm, matching the stated socket ring) reused for grooves, sockets, and window slots, per BLOCKS.md's shared_positions discipline, so the three windows on each disc and the 8 sockets below are guaranteed to be describable in the same coordinate list rather than three lists that could quietly drift apart.

Marker peg footprint ('~11mm across the base') is given once for all four cross-sections (triangular/square/pentagonal/hexagonal) without per-shape apothem/circumradius. Modeled all four with the same 11x11mm bounding footprint against the same 14mm socket, since the idea explicitly wants them tellable-apart by cross-section shape alone, not by size.

art_direction's hero silhouette mentions a 'sunburst finial cap' topping the tower, but idea.json's components list has no such part. As translator, not designer, I did not add a component for it; flagging here rather than inventing new geometry the idea never authorized as a buildable part.
